The '''2017–18 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Ohio University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bobcats, led by fourth-year head coach [[Saul Phillips (basketball)|Saul Phillips]], played their home games at the [[Convocation Center (Ohio University)|Convocation Center]] in [[Athens, Ohio]] as a member of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ohio.edu/building-directory/convocation-center|title=Convocation Center|website=Ohio University|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/coaches/saul-phillips-1.html|title=Saul Phillips|website=Sports Reference|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}</ref> They finished the season 14–17, 7–11 in [[2017–18 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC play]] to finish in a tie for fourth place in the East Division. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Miami RedHawks men's basketball team|Miami (OH)]].

==Previous season==

{{main|2016–17 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team}}
The [[2016–17 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team|Bobcats]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 20–10, 11–7 in MAC play to finish in a tie for second place in the East Division. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2017 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Toledo]] before losing to eventual tournament champion [[2016–17 Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball team|Kent State]] in the semifinals.
